red.head: 021718f054946bf95f3be04e6f21523a0e7f4404
evidence: Existing sequential acquireLock can leave the first scope active when the second scope conflicts.
acquireLocksAtomically, normalizeLockScope export and GWC-5 task/lock adapter were absent.

selfReview.correction: Atomic acquisition now reuses a same-session active lock only when that lockId is already projected in the required session record; otherwise it fails closed with LOCK_SESSION_PROJECTION_UNSETTLED.
Governed Lock EvidenceRef now projects repository and task bindings already encoded by repository:/task: lock scopes, while retaining session binding and digest.

policy: normalize with existing Lock Service scope rules
deduplicate and lexicographically sort normalized scopes before mutation
check every conflicting active scope before any grant is committed
commit all new lock records in one existing lock-store atomic update
commit session projection in one existing session-store atomic update and increment owner session revision at most once for the set
compensate every newly-created lock to RELEASED if session projection fails
reuse already-owned active locks only when their ids are already projected into the current expected session revision
repository type is future-target-compatible but runtime normalization remains fail-closed on Patricked-code/MCP until GWC-10

behavior: GW-13/GW-14/GW-15/GW-18/GW-19/GW-20 wrappers observe existing Live State, Task Queue and Lock Service outputs without transitioning tasks or granting authorization.
planMinimalLockSet is pure, bounded, deterministic and delegates scope validation to the existing Lock Service normalizer.
acquireLocksAtomically is additive inside the existing Governed Lock Service; single-scope acquireLock remains unchanged.
all-or-nothing active grant is enforced for multi-scope acquisition under the existing atomic store model.
competing reversed lock plans cannot split ownership or deadlock within the current process/store authority.
cross-store session projection failure compensates the entire newly-created lock set.
same-session unsettled lock projections fail closed and require reconciliation.
Task Queue source blob and ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS are byte-identical to the GWC-5 start baseline.
reconcileIntent OUT_OF_SCOPE is preserved verbatim by wrappers.
M1 digests and known repository/task/session bindings are preserved in GWC-5 EvidenceRef projections.
implementation.authorityBoundary: Governed Task Queue remains sole task identity/classification/lifecycle authority; Governed Lock Service remains sole lock grant/TTL/release authority; Live State remains observed-reality authority; no second queue, lock system or durable GWC workflow cursor was created.

concurrentIntake003.ruleApplied: Resume existing GWC-5 ACTIVE claim; on release dispatch requeued GWC-4 before later work.

nextAction: Release GWC-PRE-E-GWC-5 claim and dispatch the requeued GWC-PRE-E-GWC-4 intake-003 recovery delta, preserving GWC-4 prior PASS and CI #1205 as historical baseline.
